verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions RTMP or HLS egress, or broadcasting a live session to an audience outside the session. The documented egress paths are adjacent features only: WebSocket adapters that output PCM audio and roughly 1 FPS JPEG frames, managed recording, and view-only attendees, who still join the session. None of these delivers live RTMP/HLS streaming to a large audience.

support.subject: As a developer, a live session can be egressed to RTMP or HLS so a large audience watches without joining the session
